🔁 M4 vs M3: Is the Upgrade Worth It?

📊 Resale Value in Pakistan

Apple devices retain value better than most. Here’s what to expect:

  • Year 1: ~85% of purchase value

  • Year 3: ~65% if in good condition

For a high-end device like the MacBook Pro 14 M4, this means you’ll not lose much even if you sell it after two years.
